name: SM_Axe_Felling_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: felling axe, 78 cm: bearded forged-iron head with a ground edge, on a curved ash helve; authored lying on its cheek (frames 5 and 15); frames 6 and 10 show the same axe leaning, a placement rotation
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Head and helve are separate swept solids that pass through each other: there is no eye, no wedge and no lip where the wood meets the iron. The helve grain is procedural streaking, not a scan, and does not follow the curve. Authored lying flat; the leaning frames need a tilt at placement and a wall or block to lean on.
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this asset dresses the placements that show frames 5, 6, 10, 15
